reviewed_boundaries: Checked-out Rust validator bootstraps authentication of exact repository, workflow, source, producer run and attempt, completed source build and ordinary capture qualification.
Authenticated GitHub artifact digest and size are checked against actual ZIP bytes before bounded four-entry metadata inspection and fixed-path extraction.
Strict manifest and extracted executable lengths and hashes are checked before chmod or execution; controller identity is bound to producer capture qualification.
Consumer reruns capture qualification; source build inputs and producer provenance remain distinct from current runner hardware.

Qualification-only coverage uses a separate target and subshell, records actual stage and exit, checks ordinary release hashes before and after even on failure, and gates sealing on successful execution without a percentage threshold.
Local orchestration validates frozen producer pins before creating resources, checkpoints them into each owned shard, and cross-checks downloaded proof, archive, reuse and manifest receipts.
Artifact download or verification failure preserves receiver cache. Exact reopened byte comparison and checked publication hashes precede deletion of the new owned synthetic cache.
Bearer cleanup is verified; owned child process identity is checked before termination. The receiver has a finite one-hour lifetime. No measured retry or automatic build fallback is introduced.
limitations: This is source review; exact-source final Linux producer, isolated coverage and actual artifact reuse execution are NOT_RUN at review time.
GitHub CLI network calls during local cleanup lack a separate local timeout; cleanup failures are reported and the receiver has a finite lifetime.

Trust includes the authenticated GitHub service, pinned workflow source, reviewed compiler/dependency inputs and exclusive ownership of the local campaign directory. This is not remote attestation or a FIPS claim.
